name: perception-pulse
description: Capture a reference frame on the regular pulse. This is the heartbeat of the perception system — every interval, Hermes takes a complete snapshot of what she perceives: GPS, depth, sounder frames, observations, interference check.
interval: every 60 seconds (configurable, should match echogram time window)
notes: The pulse interval should be no longer than the echogram time window to ensure no temporal gaps in the data.

name: interference-check
description: Check the sounder for vertical interference lines. If detected, alert Casey to check radar — another boat's sonar is interfering with ours.
action: check sounder for vertical lines, alert if found
notes: Vertical lines mean another boat is fishing nearby with a similar-frequency sonar. High severity should trigger a check_radar recommendation.

name: depth-line-check
description: Check whether the vessel is still on the correct side of the 51-fathom line. Alert if crossing into shallow water.
action: check depth relationship and alert if crossing shallow
notes: Crossing onto the shallow side of the 51-fathom line means gear is at risk of dragging bottom. Immediate alert needed.

name: midnight-reanalysis
description: Reanalyze today's frames with the latest models. Old frames + new models = better understanding. Run when the boat is likely tied up or not actively fishing.
action: reprocess all frames from the previous day through updated detection models
notes: This is how Hermes gets smarter over time. Today's identification is tomorrow's reanalysis.

name: embedding-sync
description: Sync new frames to the collective unconscious embedding store. Enables semantic search and similarity queries.
action: embed all new frames since last sync
notes: Batch embedding is more efficient than per-frame. Accumulate and sync periodically.

name: catch-correlation
description: When a catch event is detected, correlate it with the preceding sounder data. This builds the training set for bite prediction.
notes: This is how Hermes learns what the sounder looks like right before a fish bites. Over time, this enables real-time bite prediction.

name: midi-render
description: Render the last hour of fishing as MIDI. Optional — for Casey's listening and for pattern recognition through a different modality.
action: collect last 60 frames and render to MIDI
notes: The MIDI rendering is a different way to perceive the grounds. Some patterns are easier to hear than to see.
